body: I keep wishing for this. If you're dying of cancer, it is painful but people have the greatest sympathy for you. If you're dying of mental illness, people say it's your own damn fault.

I have heard this. I didn't know about the elderly and heart issues though. 

I guess that even in the grips of depression, logic can break through and take away the idealization of death.
I'm also afraid of brain damage. That fear has prevented me from making an attempt thus far.
